<!-- prop-1: body_md -->
If $ 0<\alpha<\alpha^{*}, u \in C_\alpha^1{(\Gamma)}, \beta=(\beta_1,...,\beta_r) $ satisfying $\beta_j=\alpha_j-2/q_j$ and $q_j>2/\alpha_j$ then 
\begin{equation}
\left\lVertT(I-\pi_h)u\right\rVert_{0,\infty}\leq Ch^2 \left\lVertu\right\rVert_{1,\alpha}
\end{equation}
and
\begin{equation}
\left\lVertT(I-\pi_h)u\right\rVert_{1,\beta}\leq Ch^2 \left\lVertu\right\rVert_{1,\alpha}
\end{equation}
<!-- end prop-1 -->
<!-- lem-1: body_md -->
{\label{lem 3.2}}
    If $u\in C^4(\tau), g\in C^3(\tau),$ then
    \begin{equation*}
        \int_\tau ((u-\pi_h u)g)(t) dt=\frac{1}{12}h_\tau^2\int_\tau Du(t)Dg(t)dt+\gamma_\tau,\\
        \text{ where } h_\tau=|\tau|
        \text{ and }
            \end{equation*}
        \begin{equation*}
        |\gamma_\tau|\leq Ch^4_\tau\sum_{i=0}^{3} \left\lVertD^{4-i}u\right\rVert_{0,\infty,\tau} \left\lVertD^i g\right\rVert_{0,1,\tau}.
    \end{equation*}
<!-- end lem-1 -->
<!-- prop-2: body_md -->
\label{prop 3.3}
If $ u \in C_\alpha^4{(\Gamma)}$ , $ q_j >4/\alpha_j, j=1,2,...r$ then 
\begin{equation}
(T(I-\pi_h)u)(s)=\frac{1}{12} \sum_{j=1}^{r} \sum_{\tau\in T^h, s_j \notin \tau} h_\tau^2 \int \partial_t {k(s,t)} Du(t) dt + O(h^4) \left\lVertu\right\rVert_{4,\alpha_j} 
\end{equation}
<!-- end prop-2 -->
<!-- prop-3: body_md -->
\label{prop}
If $u\in C^4_\alpha(\Gamma)$, $q_j>4/\alpha_j$ for $j=1,2,...r$ 
$\alpha_j=a_j-2/q_j$
and $a_j>2/q_j$
then   
\begin{equation}
    \begin{split}
        &(T(I-\pi_h)T(I-\pi_h)u)(s)\\
        &=\frac{1}{144} \sum_{j_1=1}^r \sum_{j_2=1}^r \sum_{\tau_1\in T_1^h, s_j\notin \tau_1} \sum_{\tau_2\in T_2^h, s_j\notin \tau_1} 
     h_{\tau^*}^{4}  \int_{\tau_1}\partial_t k(s,t) \left( \int_{\tau_2}\partial_t\partial_s k(s,t) Du(t)dt\right)dt
      + \mathcal{O}(h^6_j)\left\lVertu\right\rVert_{8,\alpha_j} 
    \end{split}
\end{equation}

\noindent Proof:
<!-- end prop-3 -->
<!-- thm-1: body_md -->
\label{thmmultetra}
    \begin{multline}
    If u \in C^{4}_{\alpha}(\Gamma), \alpha < \alpha^{*}, \alpha_j=2-q_j, q_j>2/a_j, for j=1,2,...,r ,then \\ \left\lVert\frac{1}{3}\biggl(4 \sum_{j=1}^r u_j^*-(4r-3)u_0^*\right\rVert_{0,\infty} \leq Ch^6   
    \end{multline}
<!-- end thm-1 -->
